data: According to its fiscal 2025 Form 10-K, Apple reported diluted earnings per share of $7.46 for fiscal 2025 (the year ended September 27, 2025), up from $6.08 in fiscal 2024 (the year ended September 28, 2024). That is an increase of about 22.7%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was $112,010 million, about $112.0 billion, compared with $93,736 million in fiscal 2024. Part of the EPS growth came from a lower diluted share count, which fell from about 15.41 billion to 15.00 billion shares. The fiscal 2024 figure was also held down by a higher provision for income taxes, $29,749 million that year against $20,719 million in fiscal 2025.
